title: Normalize paths inside a virtual root
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for payload["paths"], a list of strings representing paths relative to a virtual root. Return {"normalized":[normalized_string_or_null,...]}. This is a lexical policy and must not access the filesystem. Treat backslash as slash. Reject a path if it begins with a slash after conversion, starts with an ASCII drive prefix such as C:, contains any ASCII control character (codes 0–31 or 127), or would climb above the virtual root at any point. Remove empty and "." components; ".." removes one existing component, but is rejected when none exists. Join remaining components with "/" and use "." when the result is the root. Thus an initially escaping path cannot be repaired by later components. Unicode names and percent signs are ordinary characters; do not URL-decode or expand "~". All inputs are strings; invalid paths produce null individually rather than failing the entire batch. Preserve the input. This task does not claim to resolve filesystem symlinks.
